name: 181. Bedrock drops OpenAI hosted tools it rejects (PR #7668) (bedrock-hosted-tool-drop)
description:
PR #7668 (fix: drop shell tool for bedrock). filterUnsupportedTools in core/providers/openai/responses.go forwarded shell, local_shell, code_interpreter, image_generation, computer_use_preview and programmatic_tool_calling to every OpenAI-compatible target. Bedrock Mantle (/openai/v1 and /v1) and the bedrock-runtime /openai/v1/responses route reject all six on every model they serve (Mantle enumerates the tool types it takes in the 400 and omits them), so any Codex-style request carrying one of them failed outright. Fix: isOpenAISupportedToolType gates those six on the base provider and drops them for bedrock and bedrock_mantle; apply_patch stays because the gpt-5.x/gpt-6 models there accept it.

Cases: (1) bedrock_mantle and (2) bedrock (legacy runtime route) send all six plus apply_patch and a function tool and assert via x-bf-send-back-raw-request that only apply_patch and the function reach the wire, with a 2xx (pre-fix: 400 from the provider); (3) openai control - the same filter must keep shell for OpenAI itself, so the drop is provider-scoped, not global.
